detail: SHIP-BLOCKER examples/platformer/src/engine/records.ts:54-57 treats acorns/time as one lexicographically ranked run and replaces both fields together. A 12-acorn/60s clear overwrites an 11-acorn/50s record with the slower time, while a 10-acorn/40s clear cannot update the faster time. This loses best-record data and violates independent max-acorns/min-time persistence; update each field independently.
